# Paper D: Delta Indexer Memo

## d1_scope
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_delta; SECTION_KEY=d1_scope]
Paper Delta Memo USES DeltaIndexer. DeltaIndexer TARGETS Incremental Note Search by detecting changed sections and preserving stable chunks when content is unchanged.

## d2_dataset
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_delta; SECTION_KEY=d2_dataset]
DeltaIndexer is EVALUATED_ON LabNotes-42. LabNotes-42 is a Dataset with repeated versions of synthetic learning notes.

## d3_metric
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_delta; SECTION_KEY=d3_metric]
DeltaIndexer REPORTS Recall@5. Recall@5 is the Metric used when fast retrieval should surface a relevant chunk in the first five results.

## d4_concept
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_delta; SECTION_KEY=d4_concept]
DeltaIndexer USES Chunk Stability. Chunk Stability is a Concept about preserving stable identifiers for unchanged evidence.

## d5_compare
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_delta; SECTION_KEY=d5_compare]
Paper Delta Memo COMPARES_WITH FluxRank. DeltaIndexer controls indexing freshness, while FluxRank controls how dense, BM25, and graph candidates are fused.
